features.feature: Freeze the current 16-prompt baseline before any prompt edits
Record exact 16 prompt filenames and current template hashes from promptRegistryManifest/readPromptRegistry
Commit a baseline JSON with schema version, registry materialHash, role count, role IDs, filenames, relative paths, bytes, and templateHash values, and fail if roles or hashes drift

Capture lattice agent_prompt output for every registry role as comparison metadata including output hash, byte count, and line count, failing closed on missing, unknown, duplicate, or divergent output
Produce a role-overlap matrix for all 16 prompts covering current status, purpose, phase, input, output artifact, command surface, capability summary, direct file access, and overlap category

Add regression checks for docs/story references and direct story-file write instructions, distinguishing policy reminders, reads, writes, process-event evidence references, and grandfather/remediation classifications

Provide a focused verifier command that reports PASS with roleCount=16, registry baseline verified, agent_prompt output hashes verified, overlap matrix verified, legacy vocabulary classified, and direct docs/story write findings classified
Expose the focused verifier through package.json test/script coverage so later prompt edits cannot silently bypass the baseline
Keep baseline verification deterministic and runnable after npm build without broad full-corpus scans, deriving facts from the built prompt registry instead of a hand-maintained role list
Make existing legacy vocabulary and direct-story references mechanically visible and baseline-classified instead of silently cleaning them in M0
Satisfy M0 exit criteria that every current prompt has a baseline hash and classification while no prompt content is edited for remediation
Do not edit package prompt bodies under packages/main/templates/agents during M0 except tests/docs needed to record the baseline
